role: Control-strengthening amendment; existing results retained, no change to the proposed method
reason: The fixed projected-herb control uses weight 0.1 while the proposed pair weight is source-dependent. A development-selected projected-herb control addresses this calibration confound in pair-identity attribution.
selection: Highest mean development MRR across the first three fixed selected-Mean backbones; save the source-specific lock before scoring this control on test. Same grouped training profiles, ridge operator, catalogue normalization and retained queries. No backbone retraining or test-based choice.
reporting: Retain both the original fixed control and this stronger dev-selected control, regardless of performance. This is a documented local extension after historical test inspection, not a blind preregistered confirmation.
